dayGrouping: UTC calendar days; source epoch seconds preserved. No device-local timezone inferred.

default.selection: Most raw check-ins then displayed GPS points among Hanover-area paired days spanning at least0.004longitude or0.003latitude degrees; display convenience, not evidence of clinical severity.

source.title: StudentLife: recorded GPS + same-participant check-ins
source.publisher: Daniel Fryer, StudentLife R-format derivative; original study Wang et al.(2014)
source.clinicalLink: Shared source uid and timestamp; no cross-study join. PHQpre/post contextual only.
limitations: Derivative contains49GPS/PAM/sleep IDs; original paper describes48students. Preserve observed identifiers; do not silently delete one to match paper.
No verified heart rate, step count or wearable sleep measurements in these four tables.
PAM picture index and sleep answers retain raw codes. Sleep display labels follow source EMA definition; no numeric sleep duration or PHQ score is inferred.
Recorded point chords are not verified street routes; transport unknown. No home inference.
